note: Active compatibility ceilings. scripts/check-dependency-ceilings.mjs fails when a listed pin or a recorded peer range drifts, and when the pin stops satisfying that range. A newer release inside an unchanged range is not itself a failure. Remove a ceiling only after its compatibility tests pass.
